summary: Review dependency and build supply-chain controls for pinning, provenance, install scripts, generated artifacts and update boundaries.

must_inspect.why: Build inputs should be reproducible enough for the project risk and release model.
false_positive_guards: Do not require exact pins everywhere when compatible-range updates are intentionally tested and locked downstream.

must_inspect.why: Dependencies and build steps may execute code during install/build and should fit the trust model.
false_positive_guards: Do not label all install scripts malicious; establish reachability and provenance risk.

must_inspect.why: Automated updates need tests/review boundaries proportional to blast radius.
false_positive_guards: Do not require a specific vendor bot.
Package reputation is external evidence; verify before claims.
